title: Design System: DSU Agentic ERP — Landing
scope: Landing page (/) only: src/app/page.tsx, CampusPortal, Navbar, src/app/landing.css, scoped under .ln. Sign-in, sign-up and the role portals are out of scope and keep their own Geist-on-light look (src/app/globals.css, src/app/workspace.css).

sand-wash.note: Literal in landing.css (outlined-control hover fill); not a custom property.

display.purpose: "ONE CAMPUS." Plaque capitals, incised (ln-cut-lg; md below 1200px; sm on phones). One line from 768px up; phones min(15vw, 8.6svh), stacked.

headline.purpose: "ACCESS PORTAL." Incised (ln-cut-md; sm below 1200px). Phones min(15vw, 8.4svh).

title.purpose: The single widely tracked secondary line in Worn Sand; left padding equals tracking to stay centred. Phones 11px / 0.36em.

body-small.purpose: Portal note, max 44ch, Worn Sand, under a hairline rule.

label.purpose: Gilt plate labels. Phones 11.5px / 0.12em; 11px at 380px and below.

label-product.purpose: "Agentic ERP" beside the official logo; hidden at 860px and below.

fonts.name: Archivo
fonts.source: next/font/google, variable weight + wdth axis, self-hosted

materials.name: granite
materials.purpose: Procedural black-galaxy granite tile; provenance in granite-charcoal.webp.json.

materials.name: slab
materials.value: radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 42% at 16% 28%, rgb(236 223 193 / 0.035), transparent 72%), radial-gradient(ellipse 48% 40% at 88% 78%, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.26), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(ellipse 40% 34% at 70% 16%, rgb(236 223 193 / 0.025), transparent 70%)
materials.purpose: Slow light/shade variation across the stage so the tile never reads as a repeat.

materials.name: sheen
materials.value: mix-blend-mode: soft-light; radial-gradient(55% 60% at 50% -8%, rgb(255 246 226 / 0.32), transparent 72%), linear-gradient(101deg, transparent 31%, rgb(255 246 226 / 0.2) 43%, rgb(255 246 226 / 0.6) 50%, rgb(255 246 226 / 0.2) 57%, transparent 69%)
materials.purpose: Light on the polish; sweeps xPercent -18 to 22 with the scroll pull.

materials.name: incised-cut
materials.value: SVG filter: feGaussianBlur(SourceAlpha, blur) -> feDiffuseLighting(surfaceScale depth, diffuseConstant 1.1, feDistantLight azimuth 90 elevation 45) -> feComposite arithmetic k1 0.6 k3 0.5 with SourceGraphic -> clip to SourceAlpha. ln-cut-lg blur 6 depth 8; ln-cut-md 4.5/9; ln-cut-sm 2.6/6.
materials.purpose: V-cut lettering on display and headline; defined in CampusPortal.tsx.

materials.name: etching
materials.purpose: Building drawing as sand linework; ground plane sinks into the stone.

materials.name: carved-seal
materials.purpose: Official seal re-toned as carved sand lettering; roundel and ring.

shadows.name: carved-socket
shadows.purpose: Seal roundel socket (on rgb(0 0 0 / 0.28)); seal inside carries drop-shadow(0 -1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.7)).

shadows.name: gilt-plate
shadows.purpose: Primary plate bevel and its single soft drop. Ghost plate has none.

motion.name: arrow-nudge
motion.value: transform 0.3s ease-settle; translateX(4px) on plates, 3px on header link

motion.name: ln-surface
motion.purpose: Inscription surfaces once: roundel, title, tagline, plates. No-preference only.

motion.name: ln-etch-in
motion.value: opacity 0 -> 1, clip-path inset(100% 0 0 0) -> inset(0); 1.6s ease-settle, 0.3s delay

motion.name: pull
motion.value: GSAP ScrollTrigger pin, scrub 0.65, length 1.6 x innerHeight, starts below header. liftEnd 0.3 (inscription fades, y -44, power1.in, from 0.03); move 0.1 +0.68 (etching to target, power2.inOut); ring 0.28 +0.5 (scale 0.9 -> 1, rotate -14 -> 0, power2.out); portal 0.4 +0.3 (y 28 -> 0, power2.out); sheen 0 +1 linear. Inscription inert > 0.2, portal inert < 0.62.
motion.purpose: The single linked scroll pull; only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Header 64px, gutter 22px, etching 136vw, stacked display, phone ring geometry, 384px granite tile.

breakpoints.name: static-ring
breakpoints.purpose: Reduced-motion layout shows the ring beside the portal.

geometry.value: --ln-ring: min(50vw, 88svh, 820px); centre 71% / 52%; --ln-land: 0.68; inner field masked transparent 70% -> #000 73.5%

geometry.name: ring-phone
geometry.value: --ln-ring: min(104vw, 50svh); centre 50% / 73%; --ln-land: 0.86; only the lower arc kept (linear mask 52% -> 70% intersected with the radial mask)

geometry.name: ring-static
geometry.value: min(36vw, 460px), right of the portal at >= 768px; opacity 0.36

geometry.name: stage

narrative.overview:
The landing page is the campus's own foundation stone: a slab of polished charcoal granite with sand-gilt lettering cut into it. Everything on the page is either stone, something carved into the stone, or light moving across its polish. The university's real seal and the real building drawing are the identity; they are carved and etched, never pictured as photographs or set on cards.

Density is monumental and sparse: one centred axis, plaque-scale capitals, one line of tracked secondary lettering, two plates. Depth comes from cutting into the surface (incised lettering, a recessed seal socket, an etched drawing that sinks into the ground plane), not from stacking panels above it. Motion is one linked scroll pull that moves the inscription, the building, the carved ring, the portal and the light together.

Scope. This world governs the landing surface (route `/`: `src/app/page.tsx`, `CampusPortal`, `Navbar`, `src/app/landing.css`) and nothing else. Every rule is scoped under the `.ln` root. Sign-in, sign-up and the role portals are out of scope and unchanged: they keep their pre-existing Geist-on-light look and their own tokens in `src/app/globals.css` and `src/app/workspace.css`, which this document does not describe and does not govern.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal granite ground, sand as the single ink; the owner pinned the palette as charcoal and sand.
Wide Archivo capitals tracked like plaque lettering, with an incised V-cut edge on headings.
Square corners everywhere except the circle of the seal.
Depth by carving (inset socket, cut lettering, masked etching), plus one soft drop under the primary plate.
One pinned scroll pull drives every moving part; reduced motion gets a complete static layout.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Sand is the only ink on the stone. The sole other colour on the surface is the official DSU logo lockup in the header, used unaltered. Warm-white highlights inside shadows and the sheen are light on the material, not ink, and stay at low alpha.

rules.name: The Brightest Plate Rule
rules.body: The only solid fill of polished sand (`sand-hi`) is the primary plate on hover. No other surface is filled brighter than `sand`.

rules.name: The Incised Lettering Rule
rules.body: Display and headline lettering is cut into the stone with an SVG V-cut filter: the glyph's blurred alpha is the height map, lit by `feDiffuseLighting` (distant light, azimuth 90, elevation 45) and blended with the fill as fill × (0.6 × light + 0.5), so walls stay dark sand and the lit lip never clips. Cut depth follows size: `ln-cut-lg` (blur 6, depth 8) for 120-148px, `ln-cut-md` (4.5, 9) for 80-115px, `ln-cut-sm` (2.6, 6) under 80px. Below 1200px the display steps to `md` and the headline to `sm`; on phones both use `sm`. Body and labels are never cut.

rules.name: The Plaque Width Rule
rules.body: Capitals are set wide (`wdth` 115-125) and tracked; running sentences return to `wdth` 100.

rules.name: The Cut Not Card Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats on the stone in a panel. New elements are carved in (inset, incised, etched) or are plates; there are no cards, blurred glass or raised containers.

dos: **Do** set every element on the granite stone (`stone` plus the granite tile) and ink it in sand; step down to `sand-low` for secondary lines.

**Do** cut display and headline lettering with the matching `ln-cut-*` filter for its size; the filter definitions live in `CampusPortal`, so any heading that uses them must render alongside those definitions.
**Do** keep plates and controls square, outlined or filled in sand, with a 1px `rule-strong` edge on outlined ones.
**Do** use the official seal and building as carved and etched material, from the provenance-tagged rasters.
**Do** tie any new scroll motion to the single pinned pull's progress, and give reduced-motion visitors a complete static layout.
**Do** keep a 2px `sand-hi` focus outline, offset 4px, on every link.
donts: **Don't** introduce a second ink colour; the official logo lockup in the header is the only exception.
**Don't** fill anything with `sand-hi` except the primary plate on hover.
**Don't** round rectangular corners; the only curve is the seal's circle.
**Don't** put content on cards, glass or raised panels; carve it in instead.
**Don't** extend this world's tokens or `.ln` styles to sign-in, sign-up or the role portals; they keep their own look.
